info.title: Influencer Studio API
info.description:
REST API for Influencer Studio platform

## Getting Started

1. **Get your API Key**: Generate an API key from your account settings
2. **Authenticate**: Include your API key in the Authorization header: `Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY`
3. **Optional IDs**: Most endpoints work without providing workspace_id or influencer_id - they'll use your defaults
4. **Check Status**: Use GET /api/v1/generations/{id}/status to poll generation results

## Resource IDs

- **workspace_id**: Optional. If omitted, your default workspace is used
- **influencer_id**: Optional. Only needed when generating images with a trained influencer
- **generation_id**: Returned from generation endpoints. Use it to check status

## Tips

- All image/video URLs must be publicly accessible
- Use webhooks to get notified when generations complete instead of polling
- Check the examples in each endpoint for ready-to-use request bodies

get.description: Get a list of all influencers belonging to your team with their basic information and generation readiness status.

post.description: Create a new influencer from a set of images. The first image will be used as the face image. Images are automatically analyzed for pose and content. Costs 250 credits.

name.description: Name for the influencer (auto-generated if not provided)

image_urls.description: Array of image URLs (1-20 images). First image will be used as face image.

workspace_id.description: Optional workspace ID to associate the influencer with

post.description: Generate images of a trained influencer using Studio 1. Provide high-level parameters like outfit, location, and product placement instead of crafting detailed prompts.

400.description: Invalid request or influencer not ready for generation

prompt.description: Optional text prompt to guide the generation (e.g., 'professional headshot', 'smiling')

outfit_image.description: URL of an outfit image - the influencer will be dressed in this outfit

location_image.description: URL of a location/background image - the influencer will be placed in this setting

reference_pose_image.description: URL of a reference pose image - the influencer will match this pose

product_image.description: URL of a product image - the product will be placed naturally in the scene

camera_style.description: Camera style: 'pro' for studio quality or 'smartphone' for casual social media style

lora_url.description: URL to a LoRA .safetensors file. When provided, routes generation through the LoRA flow. Pair with lora_type to select the correct base model.

lora_type.description: LoRA base model. Accepted values: 'flux-2-klein', 'z-image', 'flux-lora', 'flux-1-dev', 'qwen-image-2512', 'qwen-image-edit-2511'. Defaults to 'flux-1-dev'.

post.description: Generate a video of a trained influencer using AI-powered planning and Veo 3.1 Quality. Provide a video concept and optional images for product, outfit, and location. The system uses OpenAI to plan the video frames and motion, generates the frames with Studio 1, and creates the video with Veo 3.1 Quality including native audio. If the influencer has a trained voice, voice conversion is automatically applied.

400.description: Invalid request or influencer not ready for generation

prompt.description: Video concept/description (e.g., 'influencer walking on beach, picks up product and shows it to camera')

dialog.description: Optional script/dialog for the video (used for audio context and motion planning)

product_image.description: URL of a product image to feature in the video

outfit_image.description: URL of an outfit image - the influencer will be dressed in this outfit

location_image.description: URL of a location/background image - the influencer will be placed in this setting

aspect_ratio.description: Video aspect ratio (Veo 3.1 only supports 16:9 and 9:16)

example.prompt: Influencer walks toward camera on a beach, picks up a product, and shows it while smiling
example.dialog: Hey everyone! Check out this amazing new product!

get.description: Get a list of all music tracks generated by your team. Optionally filter by workspace.

post.description: Generate a music track using Suno AI. Provide a title, optional style, lyrics, and vocal preferences. The track is generated asynchronously — poll GET /api/v1/generations/{id}/status for the result.

lyrics.description: Lyrics for the song. Leave empty for instrumental.

vocal_gender.description: Vocal gender preference: 'm' for male, 'f' for female

example.title: Summer Vibes
example.lyrics:
Walking on sunshine, feeling alive
Every moment is a reason to thrive

get.description: Get details of a specific music track by its ID, including title, style, audio URL, and status.

403.description: Workspace does not belong to team

get.description: Get a list of all voices belonging to your team. Optionally filter by influencer_id using a query parameter.

post.description: Create a new AI voice by cloning from an audio file or designing from a text description. Optionally associate with an influencer. Clone uses Cartesia voice cloning; design uses MiniMax voice design.

method.description: Voice creation method: 'clone' from audio or 'design' from text prompt

influencer_id.description: Optional influencer ID to associate the voice with

audio_url.description: Required for 'clone' method: public URL of audio to clone

prompt.description: Required for 'design' method: text description of the desired voice

get.description: Get details of a specific voice by its ID, including the Cartesia voice ID for TTS generation.

Returns all supported image models with their capabilities, settings, and LoRA support. Models with supports_lora: true also include a lora_types array listing accepted lora_type values (e.g. 'flux-2-klein', 'z-image') for use alongside lora_url.
Returns all supported video models with their capabilities and settings.

post.description: Generate face images using multiple AI models (Grok Imagine + 14 FAL models) for maximum variety. Each image is generated by a different model. Batch 1-10 faces per request. Poll GET /api/v1/generations/{id}/status for results.

prompt.description: Text description of the face to generate (e.g., 'beautiful woman with green eyes, natural lighting')

negative_prompt.description: Things to avoid in the generated face

batch.description: Number of face images to generate (1-10)

example.prompt: beautiful woman with green eyes, natural lighting, professional headshot

post.description: Generate images using a unified model name (e.g., 'nano-banana-2', 'flux-ultra', 'seedream-5'). If init_image is provided, the model's image-to-image variant is used automatically; otherwise text-to-image. Use lora_url to apply a custom LoRA (.safetensors) and lora_type to select the base model (e.g. 'flux-2-klein', 'z-image'). See GET /api/v1/models/images for all models and their accepted lora_types.

prompt.description: Text description of the image to generate.

negative_prompt.description: Things to avoid in the generated image

model.description: AI model to use for generation. Use short names like 'nano-banana-2', 'flux-ultra', 'seedream-5'. Auto-routes to text-to-image or image-to-image based on whether init_image is provided.

influencer_id.description: Optional: ID of a trained influencer. If an influencer is used, studio-1 model will be used.

lora_url.description: Optional: URL of a LoRA weights file (.safetensors) to apply custom style or character consistency. Only works with LoRA-compatible models — see GET /api/v1/models/images for models marked with supports_lora.

lora_type.description: LoRA base model. Accepted values: 'flux-2-klein', 'z-image', 'flux-lora', 'flux-1-dev', 'qwen-image-2512', 'qwen-image-edit-2511'. Defaults to 'flux-1-dev'.

batch.description: Number of images to be generated.

init_image.description: Optional: URL of an initial image

example.prompt: A professional headshot of a person in business attire, studio lighting

post.description: Edit an existing image using AI inpainting with a text prompt

403.description: Workspace does not belong to team

image_url.description: Public URL of the image to edit

prompt.description: Description of the edits to make to the image

additional_images.description: Optional: Additional reference images for context

webhook.description: Optional: Webhook URL to receive completion notifications

example.prompt: change the background to a beach

post.description: Generate a video using a unified model name (e.g., 'kling-3', 'veo-3.1', 'sora-2'). If first_frame_image is provided, the model's image-to-video variant is used automatically; otherwise text-to-video.

400.description: Invalid request or model not found

403.description: Workspace does not belong to team

prompt.description: Text description of the video to generate.

model.description: Video generation model. Use short names like 'kling-3', 'veo-3.1', 'sora-2'. Auto-routes to text-to-video or image-to-video based on whether first_frame_image is provided.

duration.description: Video duration in seconds. Range: 1-10, Default: 5

first_frame_image.description: Optional: URL of image to use as first frame

webhook.description: Optional: Webhook URL to receive completion notifications

example.prompt: A person walking through a city, cinematic

post.description: Generate a lip-synced video by synchronizing video with audio

400.description: Invalid request or model not found

video_url.description: Public URL of the video file to lip-sync

audio_url.description: Public URL of the audio file to sync with

generation_id.description: Optional: Existing generation ID to add this lip-sync to

post.description: Transfer movements from a reference video to a character image using Kling 3.0 Pro motion control. Supports element binding for facial consistency (requires character_orientation="video"). Automatically handles video compression.

403.description: Workspace does not belong to team

video_url.description: Public URL of the reference video containing the motion to transfer

image_url.description: Public URL of the character/subject image to apply motion to

prompt.description: Optional: Text description to guide the motion control generation. Use @Element1 to reference a bound element.

character_orientation.description: Character orientation relative to the reference video. 'video' keeps the orientation from the reference video (max 30s), 'image' preserves the orientation from the character image (max 10s). Default: 'video'

frontal_image_url.description: Frontal face image URL for the element. Used for facial consistency binding.

reference_image_urls.description: Optional: Additional reference images from different angles (1-3 images)

element.description: Optional: Face element for identity preservation (Kling 3.0 only). Requires character_orientation='video'. Reference in prompt as @Element1.

post.description: Generate a video using WAN 2.2 14B with custom LoRA weights. Pass multiple LoRAs (e.g. high-noise + low-noise variants) together for best results. When image_url is provided, runs image-to-video (I2V); otherwise runs text-to-video (T2V). This call is synchronous and returns the video URL directly — no polling required.

mode.description: Generation mode: 't2v' for text-to-video, 'i2v' for image-to-video.

prompt.description: Text prompt describing the video content.

image_url.description: Source image URL. Required when mode is 'i2v'.

path.description: URL to the LoRA .safetensors file. Pass high-noise and low-noise variants as separate entries in this array.

scale.description: LoRA weight scale. Adjust to control influence strength. Default: 1.0

transformer.description: Which transformer block this LoRA targets. Use 'high' for the high-noise variant and 'low' for the low-noise variant. Required for WAN 2.2 dual-LoRA setups.

loras.description: LoRA weights to apply. Include both high-noise and low-noise variants together for best results, each with their own scale.

num_frames.description: Number of frames to generate (17–161). Default: 81

num_inference_steps.description: Inference steps. Higher = better quality, slower. Default: 27

enable_prompt_expansion.description: Use LLM to expand the prompt with extra detail. Default: false

example.prompt: A beautiful woman walks confidently along a sunlit beach, slow motion, cinematic

post.description: Generate a video from reference images and text using Kling 3.0 Pro reference-to-video. Supports character/object elements for identity consistency, multi-shot prompts, start/end frames, voice conversion, and product/outfit/location images.

403.description: Workspace does not belong to team

prompt.description: Text description of the video to generate. Use @Element1, @Element2, etc. to reference character/object elements in the prompt. If influencer_id is provided, the influencer is automatically mapped to @Element1.

influencer_id.description: Optional: ID of a trained influencer to use as a character element. The influencer's images are automatically resolved and mapped to @Element1 in the prompt. Requires the influencer to be ready for generation.

frontal_image_url.description: Primary frontal image URL of the character or object

reference_image_urls.description: Optional: Additional reference images (max 3) for better identity consistency

elements.description: Optional: Character/object elements for identity-consistent video generation. Each element gets an @Element{N} reference for the prompt. Cannot be used together with influencer_id.

image_urls.description: Optional: Style or background reference images (max 2). Referenced as @Image1, @Image2 in the prompt.

start_image_url.description: Optional: Image to use as the first frame of the video

end_image_url.description: Optional: Image to use as the last frame of the video

duration.description: Duration of this segment in seconds (e.g. '5')

multi_prompt.description: Optional: Multi-shot video with different prompts per segment. When provided, the main prompt is ignored and each segment uses its own prompt and duration.

duration.description: Video duration in seconds. Options: '5', '10'. Default: '5'. Ignored when multi_prompt is provided.

script.description: Optional: Dialogue script for the character. Embedded into the prompt to generate lip movements.

voice_id.description: Optional: Voice ID for post-generation voice conversion. Use a voice from GET /api/v1/voices.

product_image_urls.description: Optional: Product images to incorporate into the video as elements

outfit_image_url.description: Optional: Outfit image to apply to the character

location_image_urls.description: Optional: Location/background images for the scene

example.prompt: @Element1 walks toward camera on a beach, picks up @Image1, and shows it while smiling

post.description: Create a talking head video from a start image and script/audio. Supports multiple models (veed-lipsync, seedance-2-talking-head, kling-3, veo-3.1, etc.), voice selection, emotion tags in scripts ([excited], [calm], [pause:1s]), and preset location templates (podcast studio, tech studio, etc.). Poll GET /api/v1/generations/{id}/status for results.

403.description: Workspace does not belong to team

script.description: Script for TTS audio generation. Supports Cartesia emotion tags: [excited], [calm], [pause:1s], etc. Required when audio_mode is 'generate'.

audio_url.description: URL of pre-recorded audio file. Required when audio_mode is 'upload'.

audio_mode.description: Audio source: 'generate' uses script + voice for TTS, 'upload' uses audio_url directly. Default: 'generate'.

voice_id.description: Influencer voice ID (from GET /api/v1/voices). Used for TTS when audio_mode is 'generate'.

cartesia_voice_id.description: Cartesia global voice ID. Alternative to voice_id for global (non-influencer) voices.

emotion.description: Default emotion for TTS. Options: neutral, excited, happy, calm, sad, angry, enthusiastic, curious, frustrated. Default: 'neutral'.

audio_settings.description: TTS audio settings (used when audio_mode is 'generate').

model.description: Talking head model. Options: veed-lipsync (default), veed, seedance-2-talking-head, kling-3, kling-3-video, veo-3.1, creatify-aurora, heygen-avatar4, omnihuman.

influencer_id.description: Influencer ID. Required for seedance-2-talking-head and when using template-based start images.

start_image_url.description: URL of the start frame / location image. Mutually exclusive with template_id + angle_id.

template_id.description: Talking head template ID (e.g. 'podcast', 'tech-studio', 'modern-home'). Use with angle_id. Requires influencer_id.

angle_id.description: Template angle ID (e.g. 'front-16-9', 'left-9-16'). Must match a valid angle for the chosen template.

static_camera.description: Seedance 2 only: keep camera static. Default: true.

camera_motion_prompt.description: Seedance 2 only: camera motion instruction when static_camera is false.

example.script: [excited] Hey everyone! Welcome to my channel. [calm] Today I want to talk about something really important.

post.description: Upscale a video using SeedVR (FAL AI). Supports factor-based or target-resolution upscaling. Priced per output megapixel. Poll GET /api/v1/generations/{id}/status for the result.

403.description: Workspace does not belong to team

video_url.description: Public URL of the video to upscale.

upscale_mode.description: Upscale mode. 'factor' scales by a multiplier, 'target' scales to a specific resolution. Default: 'factor'

upscale_factor.description: Upscale multiplier. Used when upscale_mode is 'factor'. Default: 2

target_resolution.description: Target output resolution. Used when upscale_mode is 'target'.

post.description: Upscale a video using Topaz (FAL AI). Supports 1-4x upscaling, optional FPS boost (16-60 fps), and H.264 output. Priced per second based on output resolution tier. Poll GET /api/v1/generations/{id}/status for the result.

403.description: Workspace does not belong to team

video_url.description: Public URL of the video to upscale.

upscale_mode.description: Upscale mode. 'factor' scales by a multiplier, 'target' scales to a specific resolution. Default: 'factor'

upscale_factor.description: Upscale multiplier (1-4x). Used when upscale_mode is 'factor'. Default: 2

target_resolution.description: Target output resolution. Used when upscale_mode is 'target'.

target_fps.description: Optional: Target frame rate for the output video (16-60 fps). Doubles the processing cost when set.

h264_output.description: Optional: Force H.264 codec for the output video.

post.description: Upscale a video using Freepik. Maximum 15 seconds. Supports 1K/2K/4K output, FPS boost, creativity, sharpening, smart grain, and flavor controls. Flat credit pricing per resolution tier. Poll GET /api/v1/generations/{id}/status for the result.

400.description: Invalid request or video exceeds 15 second limit

403.description: Workspace does not belong to team

video_url.description: Public URL of the video to upscale. Maximum 15 seconds.

fps_boost.description: Optional: Enable frame rate boost. Default: false

creativity.description: Optional: Creativity level (0-100). Higher values add more detail. Default: 0

flavor.description: Optional: Output style. 'vivid' for more vibrant colors, 'natural' for realistic output. Default: 'natural'

post.description: Generate a 3D model from a text prompt using Meshy v6.

403.description: Workspace does not belong to team

prompt.description: Text description of the 3D model to generate.

init_image.description: Optional: Image URL for image-to-3D generation

mode.description: Generation mode. 'preview' is faster, 'full' is higher quality. Default: full

art_style.description: Art style for the 3D model. Default: realistic

topology.description: Mesh topology. 'quad' is better for animation/rigging. Default: triangle

symmetry_mode.description: Symmetry mode. 'auto' detects automatically. Default: auto

should_remesh.description: Enable remeshing for cleaner topology. Default: true

is_a_t_pose.description: Generate character in A/T pose for rigging. Default: false

enable_pbr.description: Generate PBR texture maps (normal, roughness, metallic). Default: false

enable_prompt_expansion.description: Expand prompt with AI for better results. Default: false

webhook.description: Optional: Webhook URL to receive completion notifications

example.prompt: A medieval knight in full armor

post.description: Generate text using supported Venice, Gemini, and OpenAI models.

403.description: Workspace does not belong to team

prompt.description: The text prompt to generate a response for

model.description: AI model to use. Default: venice-uncensored

temperature.description: Controls randomness. Lower = more focused, Higher = more creative. Range: 0-2. Default: 0.7

max_tokens.description: Maximum tokens to generate. Range: 1-16000. Default: 16000

system_prompt.description: Optional system prompt to set AI behavior and context

example.prompt: Write a creative story about a dog

settings.system_prompt: You are a helpful teacher who explains complex topics simply

get.description: Check the status of any generation by its generation_id. Use this to poll for completion after creating an image, video, music, 3D model, or any async generation. The response includes the overall status (queued, processing, completed, failed), result URLs for completed items, per-item details with individual statuses, and credits used. Poll every 2-5 seconds until status is "completed" or "failed".

200.description: Generation status with item details and result URLs

403.description: Workspace does not belong to team

get.description: Returns all available one-time credit purchase plans
Returns the total credit balance for the authenticated team

post.description: Create a Stripe checkout session to purchase credits (one-time purchases only)

success_url.description: Optional: URL to redirect after successful payment

cancel_url.description: Optional: URL to redirect if payment is cancelled

dispute_policy_acknowledged.description: Must be true. By calling this endpoint you acknowledge the dispute evidence policy described at /dispute-policy. See https://influencerstudio.com/dispute-policy

signature_name.description: Optional: your typed-name signature acknowledging the dispute policy for this charge.
